title: Bubbles break on surfaces of impossible futures as we swim in realities, dancing in what is known Kicks Of cousins' Embrace rewrites Fate in splashes
summary: Bubbles break on surfaces of impossible futures as we swim in realities, dancing in what is known Kicks Of cousins' Embrace rewrites Fate in splashes of histories Unwinding mysteries You, Danny, Ollie, and little RZA dance in water Fun fodder no one will Recall for love and Memory defined by soul And heart not broken possibility.
author: Greg McVerry
